destinations.name: Addis Ababa
destinations.description: The vibrant capital city of Ethiopia, known for its rich history, diverse culture, and bustling markets.

attractions.name: National Museum of Ethiopia
attractions.description: Home to the famous fossilized remains of Lucy, our early human ancestor.

attractions.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral
attractions.description: The final resting place of Emperor Haile Selassie.

attractions.name: Merkato
attractions.description: One of the largest open-air markets in Africa.

travelInfo.tips: Use Ride or Feres for easy transportation.

destinations.name: Lalibela
destinations.description: The holy city famous for its monolithic rock-hewn churches, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

attractions.name: Bete Giyorgis (Church of St. George)
attractions.description: The most famous and spectacular of the rock-hewn churches.

attractions.name: Northern Group Churches
attractions.description: A cluster of beautiful rock-hewn churches connected by tunnels.

travelInfo.tips: Wear easy-to-remove shoes while visiting churches.

destinations.name: Hawassa
destinations.description: A beautiful lakeside city known for its vibrant fish market and relaxing atmosphere.

attractions.name: Lake Hawassa
attractions.description: Famous for its stunning sunsets and abundance of Marabou storks.

attractions.name: Fish Market (Amora Gedel)
attractions.description: A lively morning market where you can enjoy fresh tilapia soup.

attractions.name: City Waterfront
attractions.description: A perfect place for evening walks and enjoying the lakeside breeze.

travelInfo.tips: Try the local fish soup at the market early in the morning.

destinations.name: Arbaminch
destinations.description: Known as 'Forty Springs', it's a gateway to Nechisar National Park and the beautiful Rift Valley lakes.

attractions.name: Lake Chamo
attractions.description: Home to the world's most impressive populations of crocodiles and hippos.

attractions.name: Nechisar National Park
attractions.description: Offers stunning views of the 'Bridge of God' between Chamo and Abaya lakes.

attractions.name: Lake Abaya
attractions.description: Ethiopia's second largest lake, famous for its reddish-brown water.

travelInfo.tips: Visit the nearby Dorze village for a unique cultural experience.

destinations.name: Assosa
destinations.description: Capital of the Benishangul-Gumuz Region, near the monumental Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD).

attractions.name: Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD)
attractions.description: One of the most ambitious engineering projects in Africa.

attractions.name: Blue Nile River
attractions.description: The majestic river flows through this region, creating beautiful landscapes.

travelInfo.tips: Book tours to the dam in advance.

destinations.name: Gondar
destinations.description: The 'Camelot of Africa', known for its medieval castles and the beautiful Debre Berhan Selassie church.

attractions.name: Fasil Ghebbi
attractions.description: The fortress-city of Gondar, residence of the Ethiopian emperor Fasilides.

attractions.name: Fasilides' Bath
attractions.description: A beautiful site where Timkat (Epiphany) celebrations take place.

travelInfo.tips: Gondar is the starting point for trips to the Simien Mountains.

airports.name: Addis Ababa Bole International
airports.description: One of the largest aviation hubs in Africa.

airports.name: Bahir Dar Ginbot 7 Airport
airports.description: Serving the beautiful Lake Tana region.

airports.name: Atse Fasil Airport
airports.description: Entry point for historical site tours.

airports.name: Alula Aba Nega Airport
airports.description: Key hub for the northern region.
